Detour no longer contacts Floatplane or uses your Floatplane login.

### Changed
- **No requests to Floatplane.** Floatplane creators, known videos and each creator's full catalogue now come only from Detour's own list, which is rebuilt hourly. Detour matches videos in your browser, so your floatplane.com cookies are never sent anywhere.
- **No Floatplane login needed.** Pick the Floatplane creators you subscribe to in the settings popup, as before. The "Log in to Floatplane" prompts are gone.
- **One permission fewer.** Detour no longer asks for access to www.floatplane.com.
- A brand-new Floatplane video matches after the next hourly list update. Until then, Detour links to the creator's Floatplane channel.
- The privacy policy, landing page and store listings now say all this.

Everything else is as in [0.5.6](https://github.com/josh345rtfvqw/detour/releases/tag/v0.5.6).

**Install:** [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/detour/lofobnkomhhicgcpejnlcibekkaiaeed), [Firefox Add-ons](https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/addon/detour-nebula-floatplane/), or load the zip below.
